name: Agra – Taj Mahal
desc: The Taj Mahal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Wonders, is an eternal symbol of love built by Shah Jahan.
tips: Visit at sunrise for golden light
Taj closed on Fridays

name: Jaipur – Pink City
desc: Jaipur enchants with its rose-hued palaces, vibrant bazaars, and tales of Rajput grandeur.
tips: Book palace hotels early
Avoid Apr-Jun heat

name: Udaipur – City of Lakes
desc: Udaipur is a dreamy lakeside city of white palaces, shimmering waters, and regal hospitality.
tips: Boat ride on Lake Pichola is a must
Book rooftop restaurants early

name: Jaisalmer – Golden City
desc: Jaisalmer rises like a mirage from the Thar Desert, a living fort city of sandstone havelis.
tips: Book camel safari at sunset
Avoid May-Jun desert heat

name: Jodhpur – Blue City
desc: Jodhpur mesmerises with its blue-washed houses spreading beneath the imposing Mehrangarh Fort.
tips: Explore blue lanes on foot
Visit fort at sunrise

name: Ranthambore National Park
desc: Ranthambore is Rajasthan's premier wildlife sanctuary where tigers roam ancient fort ruins.
tips: Book safari 3 months ahead
Morning safaris are best

name: Pushkar
desc: Pushkar is a sacred town wrapped around a holy lake, famous for its Brahma Temple and camel fair.
tips: Visit during Camel Fair in Nov
Respect religious customs – no meat/alcohol

name: Delhi – Capital City
desc: Delhi layers thousands of years of history — Mughal, British, and modern — in one vibrant megacity.
tips: Use Metro to avoid traffic
Street food at Chandni Chowk is unmissable

name: Amritsar – Golden Temple
desc: Amritsar is home to the Golden Temple, the holiest Sikh shrine, shimmering in a sacred pool.
tips: Free langar served 24/7
Wagah ceremony at sunset is spectacular

name: Srinagar – Dal Lake
desc: Srinagar enchants with its shikara-dotted Dal Lake, Mughal gardens, and snow-framed mountains.
tips: Stay in a houseboat for the full experience
Visit Tulip Garden in April

name: Gulmarg
desc: Gulmarg offers Asia's highest gondola, world-class skiing in winter, and meadows of wildflowers in summer.
tips: Book gondola tickets in advance
Ski equipment available on rent

name: Pahalgam
desc: Pahalgam is a serene valley of pine forests and gushing rivers, base camp for the Amarnath Yatra.
tips: Best Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct
Carry warm layers even in summer

name: Leh-Ladakh
desc: Ladakh stuns with Pangong Lake, ancient monasteries, and some of the world's highest motorable roads.
tips: Acclimatize 2 days in Leh
Carry altitude medicine

name: Shimla
desc: Shimla is a charming colonial hill station with a toy train, Mall Road, and Himalayan panoramas.
tips: Take toy train from Kalka for the full experience
Avoid Christmas week rush

name: Manali
desc: Manali is a high-altitude adventure hub of glaciers, apple orchards, and thrilling mountain roads.
tips: Check Rohtang road status before going
Book early for summer holidays

name: Dharamshala & McLeodganj
desc: Dharamshala, home to the Dalai Lama, blends Tibetan Buddhist culture with Himalayan trekking trails.
tips: Get permit for Triund trek
Best Sep-Nov for clear skies

name: Spiti Valley
desc: Spiti is a cold desert mountain valley dotted with ancient mud monasteries and lunar landscapes.
tips: Route via Manali open Jun-Sep only
Carry cash — no ATMs in villages

name: Kasol
desc: Kasol is a tiny backpacker haven in Parvati Valley with lush forests, clear rivers, and café culture.
tips: Trek to Kheerganga (12 km) for hot springs
Pack warm clothes even in summer

name: Dalhousie
desc: Dalhousie is a peaceful colonial hill station of pine-clad ridges, Victorian churches, and Himalayan views.
tips: Visit Khajjiar (18 km away) for Switzerland vibes
Carry warm clothes year-round

name: Khajjiar
desc: Khajjiar is a lush saucer-shaped meadow framed by cedar forests and the Dhauladhar range.
tips: Can be done as day trip from Dalhousie
Best Apr-Jun

name: Haridwar
desc: Haridwar is a sacred city on the Ganges where pilgrims take holy dips and the Ganga Aarti mesmerises at sunset.
tips: Ganga Aarti at sunset is unmissable
Avoid Kumbh Mela unless planned ahead

name: Rishikesh
desc: Rishikesh combines white-water rafting, yoga ashrams, and ancient temples on the Ganges.
tips: Book rafting in advance
Attend sunrise yoga on the banks

name: Mussoorie
desc: Mussoorie is a charming ridge-top hill station with sweeping valley views, waterfalls, and a lively Mall Road.
tips: Visit on weekdays to avoid crowds
Cable car to Gun Hill for panoramic views

name: Nainital
desc: Nainital is a picturesque hill station centered on a shimmering lake surrounded by wooded hills.
tips: Boating on Naini Lake is a must
Avoid Oct-Dec for clear weather

name: Valley of Flowers
desc: The Valley of Flowers is a UNESCO World Heritage Site bursting with 500+ species of alpine wildflowers.
tips: Open Jul-Sep only
Trek 14 km from Govindghat

name: Auli
desc: Auli is India's premier ski resort with panoramic views of Nanda Devi and Himalayan peaks.
tips: Best skiing Jan-Mar
Ropeway from Joshimath is spectacular

name: Varanasi
desc: Varanasi is the world's oldest living city — a spiritual epicenter of burning ghats, temple bells, and Ganga Aarti.
tips: Wake at 4am for Ganga Aarti
Visit Sarnath (10 km) where Buddha gave first sermon

name: Lucknow
desc: Lucknow is a city of Nawabi elegance — biryani, kebabs, chikankari embroidery, and Mughal architecture.
tips: Iftari at Chowk during Ramadan is special
Visit Hazratganj for chikankari shopping

name: Khajuraho
desc: Khajuraho's medieval temples are UNESCO-listed masterpieces of erotic and devotional sculpture.
tips: Sound & Light show is unmissable
Hire a certified guide for temple explanations

name: Gwalior
desc: Gwalior Fort is one of India's grandest hill forts, commanding views over the city below.
tips: Fort is spectacular at dusk
Great day trip from Agra (120 km)

name: Sanchi
desc: Sanchi has the oldest stone structures in India — the Great Stupa built by Emperor Ashoka for the Buddha.
tips: Can be combined with Bhopal trip
Quiet and uncrowded — ideal for reflection

name: Kanha National Park
desc: Kanha inspired Rudyard Kipling's Jungle Book — now a premier tiger reserve with grasslands and sal forests.
tips: Book safari 3 months ahead in peak season
Morning safaris offer best tiger sightings

name: Bandhavgarh National Park
desc: Bandhavgarh has one of India's highest tiger densities, making it the best park for guaranteed sightings.
tips: Zone Tala has best tiger density
Book 3 months ahead for peak season

name: Pachmarhi
desc: Pachmarhi is Madhya Pradesh's only hill station — waterfalls, ancient caves, and dense Satpura forests.
tips: Jata Shankar cave is uniquely spiritual
Best Oct-Feb for waterfalls

name: Mumbai – Gateway of India
desc: Mumbai pulses with Bollywood glamour, colonial heritage, street food, and the iconic Marine Drive coastline.
tips: Use local trains for authentic experience
Elephanta Caves need a 1hr ferry ride

name: Ajanta & Ellora Caves
desc: Ajanta and Ellora are UNESCO rock-cut cave complexes with Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain masterpieces.
tips: Ajanta closed Mondays, Ellora closed Tuesdays
Hire a guide for historical context

name: Lonavala & Khandala
desc: Lonavala is a misty hill station of waterfalls, ancient caves, and viewpoints above the Deccan plateau.
tips: Spectacular in monsoon Jul-Sep
Avoid weekends from Mumbai

name: Mahabaleshwar
desc: Mahabaleshwar is a lush hill station of strawberry farms, five rivers, and sweeping valley viewpoints.
tips: Fresh strawberries Mar-May
Best views at Arthur's Seat

name: Matheran
desc: Matheran is India's only car-free hill station reached by a toy train — a peaceful red-laterite plateau.
tips: No vehicles allowed inside — hire a horse
Best Oct-Jun, avoid monsoon for trekking

name: Pune
desc: Pune is a vibrant city of education, startups, and history with Shaniwar Wada palace and Aga Khan Palace.
tips: Best for day trips to forts and ghats
Vibrant cafe culture in Koregaon Park

name: Ganpatipule
desc: Ganpatipule is a pristine coastal town famous for its self-formed Ganpati idol facing the Arabian Sea.
tips: Combine with Ratnagiri Alphonso mango trail
Peaceful alternative to Goa

name: Goa – Beaches & Heritage
desc: Goa blends Portuguese heritage with Indian coastal charm — golden beaches, seafood shacks, and vibrant nightlife.
tips: Rent a scooter for beach hopping
Avoid peak Dec-Jan for budget travel

name: Rann of Kutch
desc: The Rann of Kutch is a vast white salt desert that transforms into a magical moonscape during the Rann Utsav festival.
tips: Visit during Rann Utsav (Nov-Feb) for cultural shows
Full moon nights are ethereal

name: Statue of Unity
desc: The Statue of Unity at 182m is the world's tallest statue, a tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
tips: Book tickets online in advance
Take the glass bridge for thrilling views

name: Dwarka
desc: Dwarka is one of the four sacred Hindu dhams and the legendary kingdom of Lord Krishna on the Arabian Sea.
tips: Temple is most vibrant during Janmashtami
Take ferry to Beyt Dwarka island

name: Somnath
desc: Somnath is the first and most sacred of the twelve Jyotirlinga temples, standing defiant on the Arabian Sea shore.
tips: Evening aarti and Sound & Light Show are unmissable
Temple faces open ocean with no land till Antarctica

name: Ahmedabad
desc: Ahmedabad is India's first UNESCO World Heritage City with Mughal bazaars, Jain temples, and Sabarmati Ashram.
tips: Old city heritage walk on Friday evenings
Gandhi Ashram is the emotional heart of modern India

name: Coorg
desc: Coorg is a misty coffee and spice district of the Western Ghats, known for Kodava culture and trekking.
tips: Best Oct-Mar; avoid heavy monsoon Jun-Aug
Hire local guides for jungle trails

name: Hampi
tagline: Lost City of the Vijayanagara Empire
desc: Hampi is a UNESCO-listed landscape of ancient temples, boulders, and ruins of the mighty Vijayanagara Empire.
tips: Explore by bicycle
Sunrise from Matanga Hill is spectacular

name: Mysuru – Palace City
desc: Mysuru is Karnataka's regal capital, home to the illuminated Mysore Palace and vibrant Dasara celebrations.
tips: Palace illuminated on Sunday evenings
Visit during Dasara festival in October

name: Bengaluru
desc: Bengaluru is India's IT capital with a vibrant café culture, gardens, craft breweries, and colonial heritage.
tips: Pleasant weather year-round
Explore Indiranagar for food and nightlife

name: Gokarna
desc: Gokarna is a laid-back coastal town combining an ancient Shiva temple with pristine beaches and cliffs.
tips: Trek between beaches for the full experience
Far quieter than Goa — ideal for backpackers

name: Murudeshwar
desc: Murudeshwar is home to the world's second-tallest Shiva statue (123 ft) rising from a rocky Arabian Sea promontory.
tips: Take the lift inside the gopuram for sea views
Combine with Gokarna trip

name: Chikmagalur
desc: Chikmagalur is the birthplace of Indian coffee, with misty estates, wildlife sanctuaries, and waterfalls.
tips: Trek Mullayanagiri for Karnataka's highest peak
Best Oct-Mar; very foggy Jul-Sep

name: Udupi
desc: Udupi is a coastal pilgrim town famous for its 800-year-old Krishna temple and the birthplace of Udupi cuisine.
tips: Darshan at Krishna temple at 4am is divine
St. Mary's Island has unique hexagonal basalt rocks

name: Ooty – Nilgiris
desc: Ooty is the classic Nilgiri hill station of tea gardens, a toy train, botanical gardens, and cool misty air.
tips: Toy train from Coonoor is a must
Avoid Pongal holiday rush

name: Kodaikanal
desc: Kodaikanal is a tranquil hill station of star-shaped lakes, pine forests, and dramatic shola grasslands.
tips: Berijam Lake requires a permit
Cycle around the star-shaped lake

name: Madurai
desc: Madurai is one of South India's oldest cities, dominated by the soaring gopurams of the Meenakshi Amman Temple.
tips: Temple most vibrant during Chithirai festival
Climb the tower for aerial views of gopurams

name: Mahabalipuram
desc: Mahabalipuram's UNESCO rock-cut monuments, shore temples, and sculpted caves line the Bay of Bengal.
tips: Best light for photography at sunrise
Can be a day trip from Chennai (60 km)

name: Rameshwaram
desc: Rameshwaram is a sacred island town where Rama built his bridge to Lanka and where land meets the two seas.
tips: Dhanushkodi ghost town is hauntingly beautiful
Walk through the 1000-pillar corridor in the temple

name: Kanyakumari
desc: Kanyakumari is the tip of India where the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Indian Ocean meet in a spectacular sunset.
tips: Sunrise and sunset are the main attractions
Take a boat to Vivekananda Rock

name: Chennai
desc: Chennai is the cultural capital of South India with Dravidian temples, colonial forts, and Marina Beach.
tips: Marina Beach is the world's second longest
Best Nov-Feb to avoid the scorching heat

name: Munnar
desc: Munnar is a high-altitude retreat of rolling tea estates, misty mountains, and rare Neelakurinji flowers.
tips: Neelakurinji blooms once in 12 years (next 2030)
Sunrise at Top Station is spectacular

name: Alleppey – Backwaters
desc: Alleppey's emerald backwaters, coconut-fringed canals, and houseboat cruises define God's Own Country.
tips: Book a houseboat 2 months ahead
Nehru Trophy Race held in August

name: Kochi
desc: Kochi blends Portuguese, Dutch, Jewish, and Indian heritage at its waterfront fort, spice markets, and cafes.
tips: Walk Fort Kochi in the morning for colonial vibes
Kathakali show is unmissable

name: Wayanad
desc: Wayanad is a green highland of wildlife sanctuaries, coffee estates, waterfalls, and ancient tribal culture.
tips: Chembra Peak trek permit needed from forest dept
Best Sep-Mar for clear skies

name: Varkala
desc: Varkala is a dramatic red cliff beach town with a sacred temple spring, yoga retreats, and sunset cafes.
tips: Cliff-top restaurants offer sunset views
A quieter, more spiritual alternative to Goa

name: Kumarakom
desc: Kumarakom sits on Vembanad Lake with a famous bird sanctuary, luxury resorts, and tranquil backwater stays.
tips: Best Sep-Jan for migratory birds
Sunrise canoe through paddy fields is magical

name: Thekkady – Periyar
desc: Thekkady is home to Periyar Tiger Reserve — a jungle cruise lake surrounded by cardamom and pepper plantations.
tips: Bamboo rafting and jungle trekking need permits
Book boat cruise tickets the night before

name: Hyderabad
desc: Hyderabad dazzles with Charminar, Golconda Fort, legendary Biryani, and a thriving technology culture.
tips: Sound & Light show at Golconda is spectacular
Try biryani at Paradise or Shah Ghouse

name: Visakhapatnam
desc: Visakhapatnam (Vizag) is a port city of beaches, submarine museums, and green Araku Valley hill resort.
tips: Araku Valley day trip by scenic train is unmissable
Borra Caves near Araku are spectacular

name: Tirupati
desc: Tirupati's Tirumala temple is the world's most visited pilgrimage site, drawing 75,000 devotees daily.
tips: Book darshan tickets online 2 months ahead
Special entry tickets are faster

name: Kolkata
desc: Kolkata is a city of intellect, art, Durga Puja celebrations, colonial ghats, and legendary street food.
tips: Durga Puja in Oct is unmissable
Take a tram ride — Kolkata has India's last tram network

name: Sundarbans
tagline: Land of the Royal Bengal Tiger
desc: The Sundarbans is the world's largest mangrove delta and home to the Royal Bengal Tiger.
tips: Book a multi-day boat safari package
Tide-dependent entry — follow guide instructions strictly

name: Darjeeling
desc: Darjeeling offers sunrise over Kanchenjunga, world-famous tea estates, a toy train, and Tiger Hill dawn.
tips: Book Tiger Hill jeep the night before
Toy train from New Jalpaiguri is an experience in itself

name: Kalimpong
desc: Kalimpong is a sleepy hill town of orchids, Buddhist monasteries, and misty views of the Teesta Valley.
tips: Quieter than Darjeeling — ideal for slow travel
Great base for Sikkim and Bhutan border areas

name: Bhubaneswar
desc: Bhubaneswar is the Temple City of India with over 700 ancient temples, including the magnificent Lingaraj.
tips: Lingaraj Temple entry restricted to Hindus
Great hub for exploring all of Odisha

name: Puri
desc: Puri is a sacred coastal town of the Jagannath Temple — one of India's four holy dhams — and golden beaches.
tips: Rath Yatra festival in Jun-Jul draws millions
Mahaprasad from Jagannath Temple is sacred — do try it

name: Konark
desc: Konark's 13th-century Sun Temple is a UNESCO-listed masterpiece shaped like the chariot of the Sun God.
tips: Visit at sunrise for the best light
Konark Dance Festival in December is spectacular

name: Chilika Lake
desc: Chilika Lake is Asia's largest brackish lagoon hosting a million migratory birds and rare Irrawaddy dolphins.
tips: Best Nov-Feb for migratory birds
Early morning boat ride for dolphin spotting

name: Patna
desc: Patna, ancient Pataliputra, is one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities and a gateway to Buddhist Bihar.
tips: Base for Bodh Gaya (115 km) and Nalanda (90 km)
Patna Museum has Didarganj Yakshi — a 3rd-century BC masterpiece

name: Bodh Gaya
desc: Bodh Gaya is the world's most important Buddhist pilgrimage site where Siddhartha Gautama became the Buddha.
tips: UNESCO World Heritage Site — dress modestly
Meditating under the Bodhi tree is deeply moving

name: Ranchi
desc: Ranchi is the gateway to Jharkhand's tribal culture and surrounding waterfalls like Hundru and Jonha Falls.
tips: Visit monsoon Jul-Sep for spectacular waterfalls
Betla National Park (150 km) for wildlife

name: Guwahati
desc: Guwahati is the main gateway to Northeast India with the Kamakhya Temple, Brahmaputra ghats, and Kaziranga proximity.
tips: Kamakhya Temple most vibrant during Ambubachi Mela
Base for day trip to Kaziranga (200 km)

name: Kaziranga National Park
desc: Kaziranga has the world's largest population of the one-horned rhinoceros and a thriving tiger population.
tips: Book jeep safari through certified operators
Elephant safari gives closer access to rhinos

name: Majuli
desc: Majuli is the world's largest river island, a sanctuary of Vaishnavite monasteries and tribal Mishing culture.
tips: Take ferry from Jorhat
Island is slowly eroding — visit while it lasts

name: Shillong
desc: Shillong is a breezy hill station of pine forests, colonial charm, waterfall hikes, and Khasi tribal culture.
tips: Day trips to Cherrapunji (50 km) and Dawki (90 km)
Carry rain gear — even in winter

name: Cherrapunji & Mawlynnong
desc: Cherrapunji holds rainfall records and hosts stunning living root bridges; Mawlynnong is Asia's cleanest village.
tips: Trek to double-decker living root bridge (2hrs each way)
Dawki river is clearest Dec-Mar

name: Gangtok
desc: Gangtok is Sikkim's capital — a hillside city of Buddhist monasteries, prayer flags, and Kanchenjunga views.
tips: Tsomgo Lake and Nathu La need permits from Gangtok
Best views Mar-May and Oct-Dec

name: Pelling
desc: Pelling offers some of the most dramatic views of Kanchenjunga from its monasteries and skywalk.
tips: Pemayangtse Monastery is Sikkim's oldest
Sunrise view of Kanchenjunga is life-changing

name: Ziro Valley
desc: Ziro Valley is a UNESCO tentative site of lush rice fields, Apatani tribal villages, and a legendary music festival.
tips: Ziro Music Festival in September is unmissable
Inner Line Permit required

name: Tawang
desc: Tawang houses Asia's largest monastery and dramatic mountain landscapes on the border with Bhutan and China.
tips: Inner Line Permit mandatory from Guwahati or Tezpur
Visit during Torgya Festival in January

name: Imphal
desc: Imphal is Manipur's capital surrounded by Loktak Lake's floating islands and the ancient Kangla Fort.
tips: Ima Keithel is the only all-women market in Asia
Inner Line Permit required

name: Kohima
desc: Kohima is the dramatic hilltop capital of Nagaland, famous for the Hornbill Festival and WWII war cemetery.
tips: Plan around Hornbill Festival for a spectacular experience
WWII cemetery is deeply moving

name: Aizawl
desc: Aizawl is a vertical city of stacked houses on steep ridges, surrounded by bamboo forests and Mizo culture.
tips: Inner Line Permit required
Visit during Chapchar Kut festival in March

name: Agartala
desc: Agartala is Tripura's capital with the Ujjayanta Palace, Neermahal Water Palace, and Unakoti rock carvings.
tips: Neermahal is best visited at sunset by boat
Unakoti rock carvings are a hidden gem
